tool_uses.prompt:
You are the Planner (role: planner, effort: high).

**Brief.** Turn the task into ACCEPTANCE.md: the observable behaviours that would make it done, each checkable by reading code or running `npm test`. Name what is out of scope. Keep it short enough to review in a minute, and write no code.

**The task.** Add word wrapping to this project: a function that wraps text to a given width. Done when every line of an approved ACCEPTANCE.md is shown to hold and `npm test` passes.

**Project root.** /private/var/folders/pv/m1k13gmn189d64ndtxdbzrjc0000gn/T/grooph-compare-spec-then-loop-B-5Qdha3

**Inputs.** The task (above). You may read files in the project (Read, Glob, Grep) to understand its existing layout, language, test runner and conventions so the acceptance items fit it.

**Outputs.** Leave this behind before you report:
- `ACCEPTANCE.md` at the project root.

You may create or overwrite only ACCEPTANCE.md, and no other file. Write no code. Do not run shell commands; if you must run one, run it bare from the project root (no `cd … && …`, no `git -C`).

Report back with the contents of ACCEPTANCE.md and a one-paragraph note on what in the project shaped it.

You are the Builder (role: builder, effort: high).

**Brief.** Do the task until every line of ACCEPTANCE.md holds. The acceptance file is fixed: if a line is wrong, say so in your report rather than working around it. Run `npm test` before you report.

**The task.** Add word wrapping to this project: a function that wraps text to a given width. Done when every line of the approved ACCEPTANCE.md is shown to hold and `npm test` passes.

**Project root.** /private/var/folders/pv/m1k13gmn189d64ndtxdbzrjc0000gn/T/grooph-compare-spec-then-loop-B-5Qdha3

**Inputs.**
- The task (above).
- `ACCEPTANCE.md` at the project root — read it first; it is the bar. Do not edit it.
- This is round 0: there is no REVIEW.md yet.

**Outputs.** Leave these behind before you report:
- The change, with tests (per ACCEPTANCE.md).
- `CHANGES.md` at the project root: what changed this round.

**Rules.**
- Tools: Read, Edit, Write, Glob, Grep, Bash.
- Run every command bare from the project root, one command at a time: no `cd … && …`, no `git -C <path>`, no brace groups. Compound forms are refused under the allowlist and each refusal costs a turn.
- Do not commit.
- Do not modify ACCEPTANCE.md.

Report back: which files you added/changed, the full `npm test` output, and any ACCEPTANCE.md line you believe is wrong or could not be met (say so plainly rather than working around it).

Explore the project at /private/var/folders/pv/m1k13gmn189d64ndtxdbzrjc0000gn/T/grooph-compare-spec-then-loop-B-5Qdha3 (read-only; use absolute paths; do not modify anything). Breadth: medium. Report:
1. Full file tree (excluding node_modules and .git), with sizes.
2. Contents of package.json verbatim (scripts, type/module setting, test runner, dependencies).
3. Any README, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, ACCEPTANCE.md, or other docs — full contents if under ~100 lines, otherwise a summary.
4. Every source file in the project — full contents if the file is under ~150 lines; otherwise exported names, signatures, and a summary. Note the language (JS/TS), module style (ESM/CJS), and any existing utility functions (especially anything text/string related).
5. Every existing test file — full contents if short; note the test framework (node:test, jest, vitest, mocha, etc.), assertion style, file naming and location conventions.
6. Any config files (tsconfig, eslint, prettier, .editorconfig, jest/vitest config).
Be exact — I need to write an acceptance spec that fits this project's conventions.
